entities.name: PMID:27490740
observations: Preterm and term piglets received dopamine or dobutamine; at tested doses, neither inotrope altered cardiac output or cerebral blood flow.

entities.name: PMID:7748035
observations: Study of dopamine and dobutamine effects on organ blood-flow distribution in term and prematurely delivered piglets.

entities.name: Preterm piglet CO/CBF
observations: In a preterm piglet model, dopamine and dobutamine infusions at 10 and 20 µg/kg/h did not alter cardiac output or cerebral blood flow.

entities.name: Piglet regional perfusion
observations: In prematurely delivered piglets, dopamine increased heart and small-intestinal blood flow, while cerebral/brain blood flow did not significantly change; dobutamine did not significantly change measured organ flows in premature animals.
